in_sanskrit.name: Chainsingh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord Kaishan's Singing Warrior
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Chainsingh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Chainsingh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Kaishan' (lord) and 'singh' (lion). This name is believed to represent a brave warrior who sings the praises of Lord Kaishan. In Hindu mythology, Lord Kaishan is known as the god of the earth and the ruler of the underworld. The name Chainsingh is therefore considered to be a powerful and auspicious name for a boy.
